recap: Cavaliers beat the Pistons 117–113 in overtime.
James Harden led the Cavaliers with 30 points (8-21 FG, 3-10 3PT), 8 rebounds and 6 assists.
Cade Cunningham led the Pistons with 39 points (13-27 FG, 6-10 3PT), 7 rebounds and 9 assists.
CLE won 3 of 4 factors: shooting, second chances, getting to the line. Effective FG% 53.8 to 50.0.
Best CLE lineup (4+ minutes): Allen, Strus, Wade, Harden, Schröder, +6 in 5:08.
Bench points: CLE 31, DET 27. Points in the paint: 38–48. Second-chance points: 15–17.
